$comment: Phase 2 mechanism-check tolerances, v1. This file is the host-side record of the bounds the check engine applies. The engine's authoritative copy is MECHANISM_TOLERANCES_V1 in packages/evolver/src/domain/mechanism-checks.ts; this file is written from it and is checked against it by tests/integration/phase2-mechanism.spec.mjs so the two cannot drift.
dtypeNote: dtype is the numeric type the bound applies to. 'exact' means the rule compares declared strings or counts exactly and no numeric band applies; it is a statement, not an unstated default.

tolerances.rationale: shape/dtype/device are exact contract fields, not measurements
a module that is attached must run at least once per declared forward pass
a real transformation of a fixed input must move the output by more than float32 noise
NaN/Inf is a defect, not a tolerance question
a trainable parameter with an all-zero gradient is not being trained
optimizer coverage compares two measured counts exactly; there is no tolerance band
a parameter that does not move over the declared steps was never optimized
an equivalent replacement is expected to stay close to the reference output
the relative bound scales the absolute bound with the reference magnitude
where the mask declares a position invalid the operator must emit zero
the worst disagreement is allowed at a mask boundary, but only within this bound
an operator that ignores its mask produces the same tensor with and without it
gradient equivalence is checked only when the operator is used in training
NaN/Inf in an equivalence gradient is a defect, not a tolerance question
a parameter-free operator declares exactly zero parameters
the total loss must differ from the bare cross-entropy, or the term was never added
the effective coefficient is recovered from (total - ce) / term, so it is a measured number
the relative bound covers float32 cancellation when the term is much smaller than ce
the term must reach backward, not only the forward total
a term that does not touch the specified logits has no gradient to contribute
mean vs sum is a declared rule, not a tolerance
ignore-mask semantics are exact: the number of active labels is declared
a hook whose branch the training path never enters has a fire count of zero
the declared hook position is an exact string
a declared seed must reproduce the same draw
coverage compares the observed sample set against the declared steps exactly
a schedule that is declared but never applied leaves one distinct value
a target that is never constructed cannot drive a training step
the observed module order must equal the declared order
each member must have its own passing report; a per-module ready is not a combination result
the combination must have a real run of its own; there is no tolerance for reusing per-module results
function ownership is a declared mapping, compared exactly
shared state is a declared set, compared exactly
parameter attribution compares an owner whitelist and its counts exactly
